description:
AI Engineer 

Who we are

Makai Labs builds software that automates entire companies. We work across a diversified portfolio, which means our systems touch a wide range of domains, processes, and operational constraints. Our engineering team is small, senior, and high-output. We move fast, hold high standards, and trust each other to take ownership without being managed.

What we're looking for

Makai Labs is hiring a AI Engineer to help build AI systems for enterprise automation. This is a hands-on builder role where you’ll work closely with our engineering and design teams to prototype, ship, and improve AI-powered products and internal tools. You’ll have the opportunity to own smaller projects end to end while contributing to larger client and platform initiatives.

Responsibilities will include

 - Build and improve AI-powered applications and internal tools

 - Rapidly prototype, experiment, and iterate across client and internal projects

 - Implement workflows that use LLMs, retrieval systems, agents, and structured outputs

 - Contribute to shared platform work and reusable tooling

 - Turn prototypes into reliable, client-ready systems

 - Conduct research, benchmarking, testing, and evaluation of new approaches

 - Own smaller projects or sub-projects with guidance from the team

 - Take ownership of deliverables and help deliver work that meets client needs

 - Write and maintain clear internal documentation

Ideal Experience

 - Senior in college, recent graduate, or early-career engineer

 - Background in computer science (bonus if you also have business exposure)

 - Experience building AI applications through internships, coursework, research, or personal projects

 - Experience running AI experiments and iterating quickly

 - Strong Python skills

What we value

 - Initiative and willingness to learn quickly on the job

 - Bias toward action and comfort with fast iteration

 - Interest in staying current with AI advancements and applying them in practical systems

 - Wants to solve hard problems

Nice To Haves

 - Experience with APIs, backend services, or workflow automation

 - Familiarity with FastAPI, Flask, or similar backend frameworks

 - Familiarity with React and TypeScript

 - Familiarity with Docker and local development environments

 - Familiarity with testing in Python or TypeScript

 - Experience working with retrieval systems, embeddings, or search

 - Experience working with OCR, document processing, or PDF workflows

 - Experience with fine-tuning, benchmarking, or serving LLMs

 - Experience in fast-paced, high-accountability team settings

Core values for Makai employees

 - Have a strong work ethic

 - Be self-sufficient and self-driven with an ownership mentality, no matter your role

 - Be a flexible thinker

 - Be congenial and a team player

 - Always be of service to each other and our clients, partners, and neighbors

Benefits

 - Fully remote role, Eastern time zone

 - Opportunities to work in-person with local colleagues

 - Generous PTO

 - Full health insurance premium reimbursement

 - 401(k) matching

 - Career growth & development opportunities
